facts.text: The ENVS entry for gym_guided_vision/InsertPeg-3Arms-v0 selects InsertPegEnv with num_arms=3, six cameras and 480x640 observations
The registry loop constructs entry points as gym_guided_vision.env followed by the ENVS class name
The six camera names are zed_cam_left, zed_cam_right, wrist_cam_left, wrist_cam_right, overhead_cam and worms_eye_cam
The observation space is a Dict of per-camera Box(480, 640, 3) uint8 pixels and an agent_pos Box of num_joints float64 values
The action space is Box(-inf, inf, (num_joints,), float32)
num_joints is 21 for three arms and 14 for two arms
The physics timestep is 0.002 s and 20 physics steps make one environment step (SIM_DT 0.04 s)
step advances the physics by SIM_PHYSICS_ENV_STEP_RATIO physics steps
step applies six left joint targets and the left gripper, six right joint targets and the right gripper, and the seven middle joint targets when num_arms is 3
The gripper normalization divides by the model's ctrlrange span and the unnormalization multiplies back
step documents the left and right gripper actions as values from 0 to 1
reset restores the physics, applies the fixed arm poses and open-gripper commands, calls forward and returns the observation with is_success False
The base step always returns terminated=False and truncated=False, and reports success only in info as reward == max_reward
InsertPegEnv sets max_reward to 4

InsertPegEnv.get_reward starts at 0, sets 1 for both gripper contacts, 2 for both gripper contacts without either table contact, 3 for peg-hole contact without either table contact, and finally 4 for pin contact
InsertPegEnv.reset draws the peg and hole placements from the global numpy RNG with np.random.uniform after the seeded super().reset
The environments are registered with nondeterministic=True because even seeded rendered observations differ slightly
close closes the passive viewer when one was opened
SlotInsertionEnv loads task_slot_insertion.xml and sets max_reward to 4
SewNeedleEnv loads task_sew_needle.xml and sets max_reward to 5
TubeTransferEnv loads task_tube_transfer.xml and sets max_reward to 3
HookPackageEnv loads task_hook_package.xml and sets max_reward to 4
The separate RealEnv imports InterbotixManipulatorXS, JointSingleCommand and rospy
RealEnv.reset reboots gripper motors, opens and closes grippers, then moves all three arms
The simulation assets LICENSE names Trossen Robotics and has three redistribution conditions

determinism.notes: the fake has fixed placeholder arm poses and pixels, no peg/hole objects and reward 0; its outputs repeat independently of seed, unlike the upstream task placement

gaps: the fake backend is an analytic stand-in, not the upstream MuJoCo simulator: it has no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, gravity, constraints, actuator model, peg or hole object, or contact-based reward; its joints follow the commanded targets immediately and its reward is always 0
the upstream renders six cameras at 480x640x3 uint8 (env.py:66-85, __init__.py:9-11); the fake returns a 2x2x3 placeholder image per camera to keep receipts small
the fake is not a recording and was not compared with the upstream environment: gym_guided_vision, MuJoCo and dm_control were not importable where the gate ran
reset(seed) does not control the upstream peg and hole placement (env.py:482, 489), so even the real simulation is only statistically deterministic
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms (40 ms per environment step) only
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state/set_state, so no checkpoint profile is declared
the upstream simulator backend (sim) is gymnasium.make(env_id) and needs gym_guided_vision, MuJoCo and dm_control installed; that path was not run here
only InsertPegEnv is served; GuidedVisionEnv is its base and SlotInsertionEnv, SewNeedleEnv, TubeTransferEnv and HookPackageEnv are separate tasks outside this package
data_collection_scripts/real_env.py contains a separate ROS/Interbotix RealEnv; its reset reboots gripper motors and moves the arms (:176-185); no RealEnv factory or hardware route is served
the repository licence remains NOASSERTION on the card and requires an owner publication decision; the Trossen Robotics assets LICENSE has separate three-clause redistribution conditions

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the lockstep fake stops advancing once in-flight work settles; the runtime latch refuses step, reset and seed until mhs.safety.reset clears it; state stays readable; no stop of the separate ROS/Interbotix RealEnv or physical arms is claimed
